feeds.title: Midwest Modern Momma
feeds.description: Hi, I am Savanah, an Iowa mom of 4 boys, sharing my love of living of healthier life. Midwest Modern Momma is a healthy living blog that focuses on returning to a simpler lifestyle & holistic health, healthy relationships, homeschooling, and more!

feeds.title: Mommy Jenna
feeds.description: Mommy Jenna is a blog by Jenna Goodwin, who shares her experience as a mom of four, including juggling twin boys and living with fibromyalgia. Jenna hopes to share her experiences advocating for her children, balancing Mom's duties, and so much more with the MommyJenna community.

feeds.title: Corn, Beans, Pigs & Kids
feeds.description: I am proud to be a farmer, farmer's wife and stay at home mom. Combine that passion with my love for my community and volunteering, there always seems to be 'fields of opportunities' for me and my family in rural North Iowa. Follow along my journey.

feeds.title: iowa girl eats Blog
feeds.description: Iowa Girl Eats is dedicated to bringing you delicious and approachable gluten-free recipes made with everyday, in-season ingredients, family-friendly content, travel ideas, and more!

feeds.title: Simplify, Live, Love
feeds.description: Written by Michelle Marine in Eastern Iowa. SimplifyLiveLove provides down-to-earth living for adventurous families. If you like green living tips, clean eating recipes, homesteading adventures, and family travel resources, this is your place.

feeds.title: Idyllic Pursuit
feeds.description: I'm Kathy- Blogger, Coach, and Speaker. You'll find practical tips on luxury, family, and budget travel. This includes travel guides and trip reports- you're sure to fuel your wanderlust here.

feeds.title: Teaching Mama
feeds.description: Teaching Mama is a education blog, dedicated to sharing hands-on learning activities for children, particularly toddlers and preschoolers. Angela shares sensory play ideas, ways to keep toddlers busy, preschool learning activities, pintables, and thoughts on motherhood.

feeds.title: For The Love Of Glitter
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Amanda Kruse - a fashion, lifestyle & travel blogger based out of Iowa! Here you will find lots of outfit inspo, sales & just every day life.

feeds.title: DonnaHup.com
feeds.description: I am Donna. I'm a Middle School Youth Director in the Midwest. I love Jesus, my husband, my family, middle schoolers, CrossFit, and travel.

feeds.title: Nina Williams Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nina - a lifestyle blogger from Des Moines, Iowa. I am a stay at home working mom who loves to rearrange and decorate my house. I started this blog to share my love of photography, every day moments, home decor, DIY, and whatever else I'm in the mood for. Follow along!

feeds.title: Des Moines Outdoor Fun
feeds.description: Erin Huiatt is a reliable resource and stepping stone for parents and families to find support and make connections within her community and beyond. Get outside! See places to play, hike, walk, and explore - all in the greater Des Moines area.

feeds.title: Cecilia Moyer Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Cecilia- a lifestyle blogger in Des Moines, Iowa. On this site, you'll find easy DIY projects, recipes your family will love, shopping deals, house building tips, and a place to follow our journey while we build our custom home.

feeds.title: It's Jolene
feeds.description: My name is Jolene and I live in a suburb of Des Moines, Iowa. I write about lifestyle, motherhood, beauty, wellness, and more!

feeds.title: Lady and Red
feeds.description: Lady and Red is a style and lifestyle blog featuring content on fashion, shopping, motherhood, and recipes by Ashley DeJong in the Des Moines, IA area.

feeds.title: Motherhood For Me
feeds.description: A place where everyday moms can read or submit their own experiences and stories without judgment or mom-shaming. It's a place to find friendship, support, and camaraderie. Motherhood For Me (MFM) is a better motherhood community - the one we all deserve to have.

feeds.title: Happily Trista
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog for moms based in the Iowa & Illinois Quad Cities. Happily Trista is for moms who want to make motherhood the best it can be.

feeds.title: New and Natural Mom
feeds.description: Hi! I am Farrah, the blogger behind New and Natural Mom. I am a follower of Christ, wife, homeschool mom of five, and am passionate about natural living! You can find things related to natural living, parenting, homeschooling, and other general lifestyle topics.
